Bio I am currently a Ph.D. student at the Department of Computer Science and Technology, Nanjing University, and a member of BigAI Group, which is under the supervision of professor Wu-Jun Li. In June 2022, I received my B.Sc. degree from the School of Computer Science at Wuhan University (WHU). In the same Year, I was admitted to pursue my Ph.D. degree without entrance examination.
